name: Priya Paul
current_role: Chairperson & Executive Director, Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Ltd (The Park Hotels)
profile: Kolkata-born hotelier (b. 1967) who leads Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels, the hospitality arm of the family Apeejay Surrendra Group, operating The Park and Zone by The Park boutique hotels and Flurys. She succeeded her father Surrendra Paul as chair of the hospitality division in 1990; the company is now listed in India.
interesting_fact: Awarded the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honour, in January 2012 for trade and industry.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from Wellesley College she started at 21 as marketing manager of The Park New Delhi, working under her father, before taking over as chair in 1990.
notes: Listed company (NSE: PARKHOTELS); IR email is company's. She also sits on the boards of DLF Ltd and Apeejay Shipping per search results. Net worth source listed as 'Appejay Surender' = Apeejay Surrendra Group.

name: Yan Juran
current_role: Director, Wens Foodstuff Group Co. (SZSE: 300498); director, Guangdong Yuncheng Investment Holding
profile: Yan Juran (b. 1962) joined the predecessor of Wens Foodstuff, China's big Guangdong-based pig and poultry producer, in 1983 and rose through vice president, technical director and executive VP to president. He was president until around 2019/20 and remains a board director; he is one of the pre-IPO founding natural-person shareholders (2.80% in 2018).
interesting_fact: A Wens 'lifer': he joined the company's predecessor in 1983 with a high-school education and worked his way up to group president of one of China's largest livestock companies.
deep_cut_fact: Since 2005 he has been vice-chairman of the Beiying Charity Foundation of Xinxing County, Guangdong (广东省新兴县北英慈善基金会), Wens' hometown charity.
notes: Still listed as a Wens director in an Aug 2026 board resolution (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2026-08-31/1225537760.PDF). Low public profile; no personal channels found. dsh@ is the Wens board-secretary office email.

name: Wen Muheng
current_role: Major individual shareholder, Wens Foodstuff Group (top-10 shareholder, 1.90% at end-2023); no executive role found
profile: Listed by Hurun as 温木恒 of Wens Foodstuff; Wens filings list a top-10 shareholder 温木桓 (Wen Muhuan), one of the company's pre-IPO top-50 natural-person shareholders, holding about 126.5m shares (1.90%) at end-2023. No biography or executive position found.
interesting_fact: Named in Wens' annual reports among the top-50 individual shareholders who held the company's shares before its stock-market listing.
notes: Character mismatch: Hurun 温木恒 vs filings 温木桓; very likely the same person but unconfirmed. Purely a shareholder, very private; only route is Wens board office.

name: Xing Weimin
current_role: Vice Chairman and co-controlling shareholder, Hunan Xiangjia Animal Husbandry Co. (SZSE: 002982)
profile: Xing Weimin (b. 1969) co-controls Hunan Xiangjia, a Shimen, Hunan poultry breeder, farmer and chilled-chicken processor, together with chairman Yu Ziwen under a 2012 concert-party agreement. He ran Baofeng poultry from 2001, alternated with Yu as chairman/GM of Shuangjia Nongmu 2003-2012, and has been Xiangjia vice chairman since Sept 2012; the company listed in Shenzhen in 2020.
interesting_fact: He and co-founder Yu Ziwen took turns as chairman and general manager of their predecessor company Shuangjia Nongmu for nearly a decade (2003-2012) before formalising joint control.
deep_cut_fact: Named a 2007 'National Rural Youth Entrepreneurship Leader' by the Communist Youth League Central Committee and Ministry of Agriculture, and also honoured as a 'National Model Agricultural Worker'.
notes: Company email is from the 2020 listing announcement (board secretary contact); may have changed. Search results (lixinger) indicate he is still vice chairman; the chairman is Yu Ziwen. Low media profile.
